conclusion: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the requirement for transparent, orthogonal EV characterization, validated assays, and production reporting prior to advancing an EV product into cross-species PK/PD and comparability testing. However, the specific program-level assertions that SGL-001 has or has not completed MCB/WCB production, validated intact-EV assays, stability-indicating potency assays, or reproducible GMP-like batch data are not supported by the supplied evidence set (which includes only MISEV2023). The MISEV guidance mandates the types of data and controls needed but does not itself constitute program-specific proof of those items; therefore the claim that the program currently lacks these items is unsupported by the provided evidence.
unsupported_assertions: Current documentation (as provided) demonstrates that MCB/WCB have been produced and characterized for SGL-001.
Current documentation demonstrates fit-for-purpose validated intact-EV assays for SGL-001 (including LLOQ, specificity vs non-vesicular particles, and precision).
Current documentation demonstrates stability-indicating potency assays linked to mechanism and in vivo PD for SGL-001.
Current documentation demonstrates reproducible GMP-like batch data (≥3 lots) with draft specs, stability, and potency reproducibility for SGL-001.
Scale-up and lot-to-lot reproducibility for SGL-001 production have been demonstrated.
Rodent intranasal biodistribution alone is sufficient to predict reproducible intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species for SGL-001 (in absence of orthogonal intact-EV assays and bridging controls).
Program-specific large-animal intranasal biodistribution studies with orthogonal intact-EV analytics and appropriate controls have been completed for SGL-001.
